name: adverse_selection_filter_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY at 5-second resolution, institutional TWAP programs and FII basket orders create measurable directional volume imbalance within each bar, estimated via bulk volume classification (BVC): buy_vol = bar_vol × (close - low) / (high - low). When this imbalance is high over the past 5 minutes (VPIN above the 70th percentile of the recent 20-minute distribution), informed directional flow dominates and NIFTY price continuation over the next 30-90 seconds is likely — we buy the direction via momentum. When VPIN is low (below the 35th percentile), noise traders dominate, liquidity providers absorb the imbalance, and 2-minute RSI extremes revert within 30-60 seconds — we fade the move via mean-reversion. The dual-regime structure avoids the classic adverse-selection error of mean-reverting into an institutional order.
core_signal_oneliner: VPIN-based regime classification: momentum-follow when informed flow dominates (VPIN > 70th pctile), mean-revert RSI extremes when noise flow dominates (VPIN < 35th pctile)
